findings.text: Global share mode updater chooses among five calculators for group shares from integer selector, with fallback to concur handling for default case via static call replacement.
Task scheduler hook clears per task scheduling statistics when statistics collection is enabled, otherwise leaves task unchanged.

Arena pool setup creates a generic allocator with tiny minimum chunk when backing map exists, teardown drains every chunk allocation before destroying pool, and growth adds sleepably obtained pages to pool with cleanup on add failure.

Arena allocation provides sleeping acquisition from pool with automatic growth to satisfy size, returning null on missing pool or failed growth, while release returns region to pool and tolerates null inputs.
Identifier table publisher exposes shard count plus six mapping arrays via RCU, while retirer withdraws exposure and defers reclamation to callback, safely handling absent tables.

Boot time debug initialization creates top level sched directory and populates standard tuning, feature, latency, domain, balancing, global debug, group mode and server per CPU subtrees, with some parts conditional on build options.
Fair and extended server controls appear as per CPU directories each holding runtime and period files that share common show and write logic targeting corresponding deadline entity for that CPU.

Group mode file presents selectable names with active choice marked, flags file lists enabled domain flag names, verbose file toggles boolean state, and global debug file iterates header plus online CPUs.

Server parameter contract requires runtime within period and period within documented floor and ceiling, with target online, clock refreshed and server restarted around installation, and enable state change reported with starvation caution when disabling.

Group mode state defaults to concur index, accepts short textual names with whitespace ignored and overlong input truncated, rejects unknown names, and installs calculator choice before publishing new value.
Mode indices map to up, smp, concur, max and tasks calculators in order, with concur also used for default handling.
Arena kernel address derives from stored base plus low thirty two bits of BPF pointer, with eight byte minimum pieces and four page default growth.

Shard layout counts cores and CPUs inside LLC set, derives shard total from size target and per shard CPU ceiling, then spreads cores evenly with remainder forming larger shards, while table allocation sizes follow possible CPU counts and fail atomically.

Single owner pointer holds tables only during allocation and free, publication shares count plus six arrays, retirement clears shared exposure and schedules async reclaim recovering owner from callback header.
Debug sequence position zero yields global header, later positions correspond to online CPUs in ascending order, and past last CPU yields termination with stop doing nothing.

Server updates serialize under runqueue lock with interrupts masked, domain debug refresh holds domains mutex, identifier publish needs enable mutex with retire also needing CPU hotplug exclusion, debug formatting has dedicated spinlock, and arena allocation may sleep.

File operation tables bind verbose to boolean read plus custom write with simple open, while debug, group, flag and server files use sequence or single sequence open read seek and release combinations.
Global debug sequence operations link start, next, stop and show handlers implementing header then CPUs iteration.

Global identifier state holds scalar shard total plus six RCU pointers for forward, reverse, shard, node, range and topology mappings with private owner pointer, and negative sentinel marks invalid topology.
Debug support state includes root dentry pointer, CPU encoded in file private data, fixed size group path buffer, cpumask scratch storage, and ordered scaling name list.
Debug iterator starts at header sentinel, advances through online CPUs in order on each step by reevaluating start, and ends when no further CPU exists.
Server enable state follows zero versus nonzero runtime, with transitions between disabled and enabled producing notice and disabling adding starvation warning.

Server show reads parameters without runqueue lock while update holds lock, offline validation depends on continued online state, server subtree creation failures leave subtree silently absent, and pool growth cleans allocated pages on add failure.

Decimal parse, range, online, backend apply, user copy, unknown name, pool creation and missing map or pool conditions each report distinct failures including invalid argument, busy, fault and no memory.
Server period maximum is about four seconds and minimum one hundred microseconds, both expressed in nanoseconds.

Group modes in order are up, smp, concur, max, tasks with default index two, scaling modes are none, logarithmic, linear, deadline selector uses zero for runtime and one for period, arena minimum order three with four page growth, and topology sentinel uses minus one everywhere.
Cache mask helper returns shared last level mask or falls back to node and singleton coverage when cache details missing, and group path helper prefers autogroup naming then cgroup location.
Pool teardown iterates chunks and releases all marked ranges before destroying pool and clearing reference.
Arena header include guard macro is _KERNEL_SCHED_EXT_ARENA_H.
